notes.title: Global Update "100nya"
notes.notes:
A new, global update of the game "100nya" is being developed. In the near future, its price will increase several times. Global update will affect platforms such as Steam and Play Google.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26773067/fb42ee1eddfd53b223b63194aa8861f887e4d6a6.png
What awaits us in the new update:
- First of all, this is a new platform. UWP is a universal window platform.
(it allows you to run games both on PCs with Windows 10, and on phones equipped with the same Operating System.)
- New Windows Store Marketplace (already available)
- The game will use new engine.
- The game will completely change its graphic design.
Throughout the various updates ...
- The game will add achievements, such as:
a) Achievements of Steam Achivments.
b) Play games
c) Achievements of XBox
Yet now ...
- The game will have three game modes:
a) "Easy".
b) "Normal".
c) "Hard".
- "Easy" mode will embody the training level. He will show where it is possible to make a move and the number of moves that is available.
- In "Normal" mode, the game will be blank. You will decide where to start the game.
- In the "Hard" mode, the cage will be randomly selected, where the game will start, and a timer will appear that will count the time from five to zero
- The spark of the game will be added. While you are getting achievements, special pictures will be opened. "Normal" mode is (secret drawing), which you can brag to friends.
And in the "Hard" mode, anime characters, from the universe of our games. .M.Y.W.
Share your impressions in the comments, write reviews. Play in our games and develop with us.

ːMYWː  Yours faithfully .M.Y.W.
